headline: Executive session on the investment of public funds related to Café Bistro.
summary: The meeting includes public input and an executive session. The executive session covers a matter about investing public funds, listed under Café Bistro.
items: Executive session on a matter about investing public funds, where early disclosure would harm the public interest
